	"evidence.tick_manipulation"	"{count} shots within 10 seconds were sent with a player tick count of exactly zero. A normal client always sends its current tick; rapid-fire cheats overwrite it with zero."
	"evidence.backtrack"	"{count} shots within 120 seconds were sent with a time up to {amount} ticks older than the inputs sent immediately before and after them. A normal client's clock only moves forward; backtrack cheats rewind the shot to hit an enemy's past position."
	"evidence.mousemismatch"	"Μόνο το {agree}% από {samples} περιστροφές της κάμερας ακολούθησαν την κίνηση του ποντικιού· στους τίμιους παίκτες είναι 99% ή περισσότερο. Τα cheat που γράφουν τις γωνίες θέασης περιστρέφουν την κάμερα ανεξάρτητα από το ποντίκι."
	"evidence.interp_backtrack"	"{count} shots within 120 seconds carried interpolation data up to {amount} ticks older than the shot's own render time while the client's clock stayed continuous. An honest client keeps them one or two ticks apart; backtrack cheats move only the interpolation data of the shot."
	"evidence.trigger_pattern.delay"	"{close} of {total} shots at enemies entering a held crosshair came {median} ms after contact, within one tick of each other. Human reaction times vary far more."
	"evidence.trigger_pattern.on_target"	"{on} of the last {total} shots at nearby visible enemies started with the crosshair already on the enemy; none or almost none were fired just beside one."
	"evidence.trigger_pattern.clicks"	"{fast} of the last {total} taps were held for less than {limit} ms, and {on} of {combat} such taps at a nearby visible enemy started with the crosshair already on that enemy. Synthetic clicks are held for microseconds and a triggerbot only fires on contact."
	"evidence.rcs.sprays"	"In {machine} of the last {total} sprays the view moved against the recoil almost exactly, tick by tick, within {lag} ticks of the recoil itself."
